findings.desc: The overflow docs name CLI surfaces that do not exist in Lattice 0.3.5. `README.md` and `docs/guide.md` use `lattice host status`, `lattice host_dispatch`, `lattice handoff_worktree_create`, and `lattice handoff_receipt_submit`, but the CLI rejects those commands; only `host_list`, `host_probe`, `host_install`, `authority_status`, `conduit_status`, `conduit_explain`, `handoff_create`, `handoff_inspect`, `handoff_accept`, and `handoff_resume` are exposed. `docs/requirements/decisions/project-vision.md` also repeats `host_status` / `host_dispatch` as if they were valid surfaces.

Host-neutrality is overclaimed. docs/requirements/decisions/host-overflow.md:5-12 and docs/requirements/decisions/project-vision.md:18 describe Host Overflow as host-neutral and say Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools are execution hosts, but packages/main/src/core/lattice-hosts.ts:298-304 only marks overflowReady for claude-code or codex by host id. A future editing host with the same declared capabilities would still report unavailable, so the architecture remains vendor-allowlisted under the hood. Fix by deriving overflow readiness from capability/profile semantics instead of a host-id allowlist, or narrow the docs to Codex/Claude Code only for this milestone.

Receipt safety is incomplete: submitHandoffReceipt treats any non-empty headSha as pass (packages/main/src/core/lattice-handoff.ts:795-805) and can return accepted-local without proving that headSha exists or matches the reviewed overflow commit. Verified with an inline node repro that submitted headSha="not-a-real-commit" and still got status=accepted-local plus validations.headSha=pass. Fix by resolving headSha in git (for example rev-parse/cat-file), requiring it to be reachable from the overflow worktree result being reviewed, and failing/diagnostic when the commit cannot be verified.

Overflow JSON contract is broken: docs/guide.md:118-122 advertise --json for host_status/handoff_create/handoff_worktree_create/host_dispatch/handoff_receipt_submit, but MAIN_TOOLS only declares format for these commands (packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:620-705) and the handoff handlers only branch on args.format (packages/main/src/handlers/lattice-handoff.ts:140-185). Repro: node packages/main/dist/cli.js host_status --host=claude-code --json returns text, so automation expecting JSON silently breaks. Fix by adding json:boolean schema support + handler support for the new overflow commands, or change docs/examples/help to require --format=json consistently.

packages/main/src/core/lattice-handoff.ts:808-824 still treats any locally resolvable headSha as pass. Verified repro: a receipt whose headSha points to an unrelated existing commit (touching other.txt, not the claimed changedFiles) still returns status=accepted-local with validations.headSha=pass. That means handoff_receipt_submit still does not prove the receipt is tied to the reviewed overflow result; packages/main/src/tasks/host-overflow-smoke.ts:306-326 only covers an invalid SHA, so this false-positive path remains untested.
